Q5291.reason: Reckless contact causing injury is battery; attempt and assault-with-intent all require a specific intent to kill or injure that he denied.

Q5292.reason: Hypotension plus tachycardia signals shock in upper GI bleeding; beta-blockade masks tachycardia, pain is not invariable, and alcohol history matters.

Q5297.reason: Intrusion upon seclusion covers electronic eavesdropping of a hotel room where privacy is reasonably expected; physical entry and publication are not required.
